objective: Pareto-optimize long-run CAGR versus maximum drawdown while explicitly measuring crash preservation, recovery burden, and behavioral tolerability.
development_foresight: Forward trajectories may be used as discovery labels only inside each 80-stock discovery partition. No future outcome from the 37-stock transport partition may enter evolution for that fold. Live/replay decisions at T use T and earlier only.

r1.role: causal market-state information; not a mandatory action or rigid ordered gate
dimensions: delayed nonlinear breadth conversion with explicit breadth level, velocity and acceleration
r1.critical_discriminator: Genuine recoveries may show late explosive/accelerating cross-sectional conversion and persistence; false bull resumptions can show strong price bounces and temporary breadth improvement without the same sustained late-stage conversion.
r1.ordering: timing and order may vary by recovery episode; GA receives dimensions separately and may discover interactions
r1.false_rally_control: large price bounce alone is insufficient

market_state: A/B/C/DEFENSIVE/R1 are causal context only. GA may choose long, short, SAFE, reduced exposure, sector rotation or combinations; market state does not prescribe action.
architecture: market context -> sector context -> stock state/behavior -> applicable strategy -> opportunity ranking -> capital allocation, as soft information levels rather than rigid gates
safe_asset: actual historical 3-month Treasury rate, causal latest-published observation only, forward-filled after publication and never future-backfilled

costs.primary: realistic spread/slippage plus regulatory/short-borrow where applicable

decline_reporting: MTS CAGR while broad market declining
time to recover prior equity high

ga.complexity_tiebreak: when economically indistinguishable within uncertainty, prefer simpler/more stable genome

reproducibility: protected cohort identities governed and unopened until stage
non_goal: Do not recreate lost GA by fitting remembered results; reinvent under horizon-free governance.
